goal: Provide convenience loaders that build validated `Task` instances from a single JSON file, a directory of JSON files, and a JSONL stream.

constraints: Loaders are optional conveniences — direct dataclass construction must remain unchanged and equally supported.
Each loader must call `Task.validate()` on every produced instance before returning it; loaders must never yield un-validated Tasks.
Loaders must not extend the `Task` schema with input-format-specific fields.
non_goals: Auto-discovery beyond the three loader entry points (no recursion into subdirectories unless trivially free).
edge_cases: Directory loader encounters non-`.json` entries alongside valid files.
JSONL loader handles blank lines, trailing newlines, and comment-like junk without producing empty Tasks.
Malformed JSON in one file/line must produce an actionable error identifying the offending source rather than a bare parser traceback.
Empty directory and empty JSONL stream are valid inputs that produce zero Tasks.

assertions: Direct `Task(...)` construction still works without invoking any loader, and the dataclass module remains free of file/stream imports.
Each of the three loaders (single JSON file, directory of JSONs, JSONL) is exercised by tests against both well-formed and malformed inputs.
Malformed inputs surface errors that name the offending file path or JSONL line number, not just the raw exception.
graders.name: loader-contract
